answer_1.quote: We evaluate FACTSCORE on the task of generating people biographies because generations consist of verifiable statements rather than debatable or subjective ones...

answer_2.quote: We introduce FACTSCORE, a new evaluation of an LM that represents the percentage of atomic facts (pieces of information) supported by a given knowledge source.

answer_3.quote: Our estimator first breaks a generation into a series of atomic facts and then validates each against the given knowledge source. We use zero-shot prompting of an LM referred to as an LM_EVAL.

answer_4.quote: We perform extensive human annotations to obtain FACTSCOREs of three state-of-the-art, commercially available LMs... We recruit freelancers through Upwork... Annotators assign each atomic fact one of three labels.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label each atomic fact as Supported, Not-supported, or Irrelevant based on verification against Wikipedia.
